metaTitle: Custom Recycled PET Golf Towels | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recycled PET golf towels for eco-friendly branding. Perfect for tournaments and corporate gifts. Shop at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Recycled PET golf towels offer a sustainable alternative to traditional cotton or microfiber towels, made from post-consumer plastic bottles. They are highly absorbent, quick-drying, and durable enough for repeated use on the course. Perfect for eco-conscious corporate events, charity tournaments, or branded retail, these towels can be customized with your logo through screen printing or embroidery. Choose recycled PET to demonstrate your commitment to sustainability while providing a practical, high-performance accessory for golfers.
